name: py-worker
title: Python background worker
description: A Python BullMQ worker that consumes the same Redis queues your Node API produces to, with SQLAlchemy models over the same Postgres database, structured logging and graceful shutdown. For work that belongs in Python — data processing, ML, scientific libraries.

queue.title: BullMQ consumers
queue.description: Workers pulling from the same Redis queues your Node API produces to, with graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown.

database.title: SQLAlchemy over Postgres
database.description: Direct database access to the same schema your API owns. Models are hand-written here rather than generated, so they must be kept in step with the Prisma schema by hand.

hooks.title: git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the py-worker template'

nextSteps: Edit .env — DB_* and REDIS_* must match the API's.
